published_ranges._notes: Requires a printer designed for PEEK/PEKK/PEI-class materials; beyond Bambu X1/P1 hotend and bed limits. Higher drying temperatures may warp the spool. Bed: smooth PEI, textured PEI, glass + Kapton tape or Magigoo PRO HT. No matching Bambu Studio system preset; bambu_parent omitted.
